items.html: And indeed, through his sin, these souls, too, were flawed, as mentioned above, and there remained in them no illumination except the measure of illumination that had been in the aspects of the last Malchuyot of the souls before he sinned. Thus, these Ketarim that remained in him have no illumination but the measure of the illumination of Malchut that was there at first, before the sin. Therefore it is called the Nefesh of Adam, since Malchut is called Nefesh — understand this. And it follows that all the Ketarim remained in him, even the last Keter of them all, which is the Keter of the Sefira of Malchut in the Nukva of Assiya.
